items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Sonny Grear from Duke Ellington's band. They had a bass player from another band. They had a girl singer and a girl dancer -- Mae Barnes was the girl.

ctx.x: Duke Ellington's band. They had a bass player from another band. They had a girl singer and a girl dancer -- Mae Barnes was the girl.
